document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Operational Guidelines (Revised 2020)
text: [PRADHAN MANTRI KISAN SAMMAN NIDHI (PM-KISAN) ? OPERATIONAL GUIDELINES (REVISED)] Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers Welfare, Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers Welfare, Government of India. The Central Sector Scheme PM-KISAN provides income support to all landholding eligible farmer families in the country to supplement their financial needs.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Operational Guidelines (Revised 2020)
text: [SCHEME MODALITIES AND BENEFIT DISBURSEMENT] Under the PM-KISAN scheme, a financial benefit of Rs 6000 per annum is provided to all eligible farmer families. The financial benefit is payable in three equal four-monthly instalments of Rs 2000 each. The instalment periods are: Period 1 from April to July, Period 2 from August to November, and Period 3 from December to March.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Operational Guidelines (Revised 2020)
text: [DEFINITION OF BENEFICIARY AND LANDHOLDING ELIGIBILITY] A landholder farmer family is defined as a family comprising husband, wife, and minor children who own cultivable land as per land records of the concerned State or Union Territory. As approved by the Union Cabinet on 31st May 2019 (effective 1st April 2019), the scheme covers all landholding eligible farmer families irrespective of the size of their landholdings.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Operational Guidelines (Revised 2020)
text: [DEFINITION OF BENEFICIARY AND LANDHOLDING ELIGIBILITY] Tenant farmers, sharecroppers, and landless agricultural labourers who do not possess cultivable land ownership title in official revenue records are not eligible to receive benefits under the PM-KISAN scheme.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Operational Guidelines (Revised 2020)
text: [EXCLUSION CRITERIA (STATUTORY DISQUALIFICATION)] The following categories of beneficiaries of higher economic status shall not be eligible for benefits under the scheme: Institutional landholders, former and present holders of constitutional posts, former and present Ministers, MPs, MLAs, serving or retired officers and employees of Central/State Government Ministries and PSEs (excluding Class IV / Group D / MTS employees), superannuated pensioners with monthly pension of Rs 10000 or more, income tax payees of last assessment year, and registered professionals.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Operational Guidelines (Revised 2020)
text: [OPERATIONAL COMPLIANCE AND BENEFIT TRANSFER] Financial benefits under PM-KISAN are transferred 100 percent electronically through the Aadhaar Payment Bridge System (APBS) directly into Aadhaar-seeded bank accounts of verified farmers. Completion of eKYC (electronic Know Your Customer) is 100 percent mandatory for all registered beneficiaries before the release of subsequent instalments.

document_title: Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) — Historical Launch Guidelines (Feb 2019)
text: [ORIGINAL SCHEME ELIGIBILITY AND SMALL & MARGINAL FARMER DEFINITION (FEBRUARY 2019)] Under the original launch guidelines of PM-KISAN dated February 2019, the scheme was restricted to Small and Marginal Farmer (SMF) families owning cultivable land up to 2 hectares (5 acres). Medium and large farmers holding cultivable land exceeding 2 hectares were not eligible in this initial launch era.

document_title: PIB Press Release — Cabinet Approves Extension of PM-KISAN to All Farmer Families
text: [CABINET APPROVES EXTENSION OF PM-KISAN SCHEME TO ALL FARMER FAMILIES] New Delhi, 31st May 2019. The Union Cabinet, chaired by Prime Minister Narendra Modi, has approved the extension of the Pradhan Mantri Kisan Samman Nidhi (PM-KISAN) to all eligible farmer families in the country, irrespective of the size of their landholdings. This decision removes the 2 hectare ceiling, bringing an estimated 14.5 crore farmers under the scheme with effect from 1st April 2019.

document_title: PM-KISAN Portal — Official Frequently Asked Questions
text: [PM-KISAN OFFICIAL FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS] Question: Are tenant farmers eligible to get benefits of PM-KISAN? Answer: No, tenant farmers are not eligible. Only landholder farmer families who own cultivable land in their own names as per State land revenue records are eligible.

document_title: PM-KISAN Portal — Official Frequently Asked Questions
text: [PM-KISAN OFFICIAL FREQUENTLY ASKED QUESTIONS] Question: What is the mandatory requirement for receiving PM-KISAN instalments? Answer: eKYC is 100 percent mandatory for all registered PM-KISAN farmers. Additionally, bank accounts must be seeded with Aadhaar and mapped with NPCI.
